rationale: The workflow is a manual (workflow_dispatch) cache-purge job: it checks out code, restores two caches, sets up JDK with Maven caching already enabled, then deletes dependency-check data directories. It has no build, install, or test step, no matrix, no schedule, and the repository CI history shows no completed runs, so repeated dependency fetching is not measurable. The closest evidence pattern, P-LIT-GHA-CACHE (cache dependency downloads), is not supported: its precondition that repeated dependency fetching is measurable is unmet (nothing installs dependencies and there are no lockfile/environment cache inputs), and its contraindication that an equivalent cache already exists applies because setup-java already enables cache: 'maven'. The remaining patterns require a matrix (P-LIT-FAIL-FAST, P-LIT-FAILED-JOB-FIRST), tests (P-LIT-PRIORITIZE, P-LIT-SELECT), a schedule (P-LIT-FAIL-SCHEDULE, P-LIT-IDLE-SCHEDULE), Bazel (P-LIT-BAZEL-*), representative duration history (P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT, P-LIT-HISTORY-TIMEOUT), or CI-service policy changes outside this workflow's scope. No supported optimization fits while preserving the intended purge behavior, so no change is made.
